Our use of cookies

You can learn about the categories of cookies used on this website and manage your preferences below.

Essential cookies

Essential cookies are used to enable core functionality of this website, such as remembering your progress through a form or logging in. Such cookies are always enabled.

Functional cookies

Functional cookies are used to provide enhanced functionality, such as social media feeds and real-time chat. If you do not allow these cookies some features may not be available.

Analytics cookies

Analytics cookies help us to understand how this website is used, providing information that can help us to improve our services and your browsing experience.

We use Google Analytics to collect this data which will set cookies on your device. Please be assured however that this data is collected in a way that cannot be used to directly identify anyone and is never shared with other third-parties.

Marketing cookies

Marketing cookies allow us and selected third-parties to tailor any advertising on this website to your preferences. They can also be used to understand the performance of marketing activities and improve the relevance of the adverts you see.

If you do not allow these cookies you may still see advertising on this website but it will be less relevant to your preferences.

Trustees - Frank Parkinson Yorkshire Trust

  • Recruiter: Eastside People

  • Remote Working: Some remote working possible
  • Salary: On Application

Apply for this job now

Job description

Would you like to use your skills and experience to help improve the lives of older people and support communities in and around Guiseley?

Then we’d love to talk to you about this exciting opportunity to become a trustee of the Frank Parkinson Yorkshire Trust.

Trustee Opportunities at the Frank Parkinson Yorkshire Trust

The Frank Parkinson Yorkshire Trust offers you the chance to help shape the future of a long-established charity providing housing and support for older people, alongside grants benefiting local charities and educational opportunities.

This is a rewarding opportunity to contribute your skills, knowledge and experience to the strategic direction, governance and oversight of the Trust. We are particularly seeking a trustee with experience in landlord or property management, housing compliance, asset management, building safety, housing operations or a related technical discipline.

We are also seeking a trustee who can make a broader contribution to the Trust’s strategy, governance and future development.

What is the Frank Parkinson Yorkshire Trust?

The Frank Parkinson Yorkshire Trust was established through the legacy of pioneering electrical engineer Frank Parkinson. Today, the Trust provides charitable housing and support for people in need, with a particular focus on older people.

The Trust has 44 almshouse units in Guiseley and provides accommodation for older adults who meet its eligibility criteria, can demonstrate need and are able to live independently. It also awards grants supporting health and wellbeing, local charities, and education and training connected with the electrical industry.

What matters to the Frank Parkinson Yorkshire Trust?

We are committed to honouring Frank Parkinson’s legacy by providing high-quality housing for older people and supporting local communities.

We are looking for people who share our purpose and values, care about improving the lives of older people, can think strategically and exercise sound judgement, and will work collaboratively and respectfully with fellow trustees and staff.

Please make sure you read our Candidate Information Pack before applying. It contains important details about the roles and our organisation.

Don’t think you quite meet all the specifications? Please don’t count yourself out. We welcome applications from people with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences who can contribute to the effective governance and future development of the Trust.

We want you to have every opportunity to demonstrate your skills, ability and potential. If you require assistance or reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process, please contact us so we can support you appropriately.

Apply for a Trustee role

Eastside People is supporting the Frank Parkinson Yorkshire Trust in the recruitment of these roles.

You can click here to apply by submitting your CV and a cover letter, both in Word doc format. Please mention ACEVO Jobs in your application.

The closing date for applications is 30 November 2026. Shortlisting interviews will take place shortly afterwards, with interviews with the Frank Parkinson Yorkshire Trust taking place on 10 December 2026.

We acknowledge every application. You’ll always hear from us after taking the time to apply – we look forward to hearing from you!
